skill_discovery.schemas: The authenticated response is the authoritative closed argument schema and per-skill setup blockers.
skill_discovery.monitoring: POST /api/skills/{name}/run; read-only, cost.read and factory.read required.
skill_discovery.actions: POST /api/skills/{name}/propose; creates a signed caller/scope-bound pending plan only.
skill_discovery.approval: POST /api/operations/{id}/approve with exact plan_hash; deletion additionally requires the exact confirmation_phrase.
skill_discovery.execution: POST /api/operations/{id}/execute; persisted approvals only, one-use CAS, never raw request bodies.
skill_discovery.status: GET /api/operations/{id}/status; read-only underlying job observation, never automatic write retry.
skill_discovery.continuation: POST /api/operations/{id}/continue with exact original plan_hash and current observation_hash; one-use CAS within the original Full bootstrap authorization only.

skills.basis: Server-approved private hub, explicit VPN client pool and default-project Full bootstrap profile.
Explicit authorized deletion manifest and phrase; preserve Entra security groups.
Configured factory/scale set; distinguish saved project configuration from Azure deployment.
Default variables.json enabled resources/SKUs and sourced retail baseline, separate from actual Azure Cost Analysis.
Explicit authorized common resource group, provisioned baseline and separate actual billing.
Exact project resource group, UTC monthly actual and Azure forecast; unknown data is not zero.
Existing Factory API health; no changes.
Exact server-selected Factory settings; no scope override.
Caller-owned persisted operation and bound job in the active scope; no arbitrary job polling.
Immediate approved purple agent type plus exact Foundry project ARM ID, one version; no implicit routing.
Immediate approved ML template type and serving_mode plus exact project/workspace ARM ID; asynchronous training, no implicit serving promotion.

scope_resolution: Authenticated caller and server-configured scope key resolve tenant, subscription, resource group, factory, project and environment. The model cannot supply scope overrides.

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.purpose: Retrieve repository evidence using hybrid Search and configured semantic ranking.
tools.scope: Exact authorized active scope, enforced as a Search prefilter.
tools.retry: Embedding throttles may retry twice; semantic/Search failures surface without ranking fallback.
tools.approval: No write approval; authenticated grant required.

tools.name: knowledge_status
tools.purpose: Observe committed ingestion state, live document count and freshness.
tools.scope: Owned corpus for the active authorized deployment.

tools.name: azure_live_state
tools.purpose: Observe actual Azure resources and model deployments; installed Factory version remains unknown.
tools.scope: Exact configured subscription and resource group, never a model-selected endpoint.

tools.name: factory_health
tools.purpose: Read the real existing Factory API health.

tools.name: factory_capabilities
tools.purpose: Read the actual existing Factory creation capabilities through its SDK.
tools.scope: Configured API and active grant; capabilities do not grant authority.

tools.name: factory_catalog
tools.purpose: Read and filter the real catalog to the exact configured IDs and authorized placement.
tools.scope: Server-selected catalog folder, factory, scale set, project and placement.

tools.name: factory_settings
tools.purpose: Read the exact supported Factory configuration and source revision.
tools.scope: Same exact configured IDs, verified against the live catalog.

tools.name: factory_cli_health
tools.purpose: Actually invoke the existing azurefactory CLI health command.
tools.scope: Configured API URL, fixed Python module and validated argument array.
tools.approval: No write approval; arbitrary shell/executables are not supported.

tools.name: factory_operation_status
tools.purpose: Read a caller-owned saved operation and observe its bound backend job without replaying writes.
tools.scope: Persisted requesting caller, active scope and exact job binding.
tools.changes_state: May persist a signed observation; never starts, confirms or continues a Factory job.
tools.retry: Read-only status may be queried again; writes are never replayed.

tools.name: cost_default_project_idle
tools.purpose: Estimate every enabled default project component from pinned variables.json and compare with separate actual MTD Azure billing.
tools.scope: Canonical server-pinned defaults and exact configured project resource group.
tools.retry: No synthetic cost or ranking fallback; bounded read pagination only.
tools.approval: No write approval; Azure billing read access is independently required.

tools.name: cost_common_idle
tools.purpose: Estimate provisioned fixed components in an approved common resource group and show separate actual MTD billing.
tools.scope: Exact common-resource-group allowlist for the active scope; no subscription override.
tools.retry: Read-only requests; unknown or ambiguous meters stay unpriced.

tools.name: cost_monthly_project_forecast
tools.purpose: Read actual MTD and Azure's full-month forecast without extrapolation or double-counting actual costs.
tools.retry: Read-only billing requests; unavailable forecasts never become invented projections.

tools.name: factory_prepare_settings
tools.purpose: Prepare a real configuration-only department metadata plan from the authenticated proposal endpoint.
tools.scope: Exact configured single DEV placement; backend validates underlying preview and revision.
tools.changes_state: Creates a pending plan/review, never confirms Factory changes.
tools.approval: Separate authenticated approval of the exact hash; execution uses Blob ETag CAS and one-use state. Destructive and infrastructure deployment operations are not exposed.
